# riskweightedassets

`riskweightedassets` is the R implementation of the RiskDataScience GmbH
reference engine for CRR III risk-weighted assets, regulatory capital, IRRBB
and ICAAP. It supplies canonical Excel contracts, realistic synthetic data,
bitemporal snapshots, deterministic lineage and reconciliation controls.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(riskweightedassets)
tables <- generate_synthetic_tables(bank_profile = "MID_SIZE_UNIVERSAL")
result <- calculate_tables(tables)
result$metrics[c("RWEA_KSA", "RWEA_IRB", "TREA", "CET1_RATIO")]
```

See the committed `README.md` and `docs/` tree for the complete project
documentation. The package contains no customer data and redistributes no
downloaded regulatory documents.
